lead.headline: Retail Expansion and Regulatory Shifts Signal Mainstream RWA Pivot
lead.tldr: While infrastructure volatility persists, the strategic move of NFT IP into big-box retail and Southeast Asian regulatory openness suggest a shift toward tangible, real-world utility.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief examines the divergence between failing legacy L1 leadership and the accelerating bridge between digital assets and physical commerce.

top_signals.title: Andre Cronje, two others resign from Sonic Labs board as S token trades 97% below its peak
top_signals.summary: Andre Cronje and two other board members have resigned from Sonic Labs, the entity behind the Layer 1 network formerly known as Fantom. This leadership change occurs as the network's S token has plummeted 97% from its all-time high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The exodus of key leadership at Sonic Labs underscores the fragility of L1 projects that fail to maintain token value and ecosystem momentum.

top_signals.title: Pudgy Penguins expands retail footprint with Target trading card rollout32m, Pudgy Penguins expands retail footprint with Target trading card rolloutThe NFT-born franchise is bringing its Vibes Series 3 trading cards to Target stores across the United States as it expands into physical products and mainstream retail.
top_signals.summary: Pudgy Penguins is expanding its brand presence into mainstream retail by launching its Vibes Series 3 trading cards at Target stores across the US. This move represents a strategic push to bridge the gap between NFT-born intellectual property and physical consumer products.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Pudgy Penguins' Target rollout proves that NFT IP can successfully pivot to a high-margin physical consumer goods model, reducing reliance on secondary market volatility.

top_signals.title: Philippines Is Ready for RWA Tokenization, SEC Commissioner Says
top_signals.summary: The Philippine SEC has expressed readiness to embrace Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization. The regulator believes that regulated tokenized products can diversify investment options and provide safer alternatives for overseas Filipino workers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Philippine SEC's openness to RWA tokenization creates a blueprint for emerging markets to institutionalize digital assets for remittance and retail investment.

top_signals.title: From Incubation to Global Operations: How Levl Built a Payments Platform with Galaxy Ventures
top_signals.summary: Levl, a stablecoin infrastructure company, has scaled to process over $1 billion in annualized payment volume following its seed funding. The growth was supported by an incubation and investment partnership with Galaxy Ventures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Levl's $1B annualized volume demonstrates the scaling potential of stablecoin-native payment rails when backed by strategic incubation.

top_signals.title: MEV Bot Jaredfromsubway.eth Exploited For $7.5M
top_signals.summary: A prominent MEV bot known as Jaredfromsubway.eth was exploited, resulting in a loss of $7.5 million. The attacker targeted the bot's automated system to drain its funds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $7.5M exploit of a high-profile MEV bot highlights the systemic risk inherent in automated liquidity strategies and the need for more robust security primitives.

on_the_radar.title: Secret Network’s Axelar bridge drained for $4.67 million in infinite-mint exploit that went unnoticed for seven days
on_the_radar.summary: The Secret Network's Axelar bridge was drained of $4.67 million due to an infinite-mint exploit that remained undetected for a week. Secret Network reports that Axelar has declined requests to freeze approximately $770,000 of the stolen funds still held in the attacker's wallet.

on_the_radar.title: Charles Schwab is working with Cboe to launch S&P 500 'yes-or-no' binary options contracts: WSJ
on_the_radar.summary: Charles Schwab is collaborating with Cboe to introduce binary options contracts based on the S&P 500. This move represents the brokerage's entry into the prediction-market style product space, currently led by platforms like Polymarket.

on_the_radar.summary: Individuals involved in a kidnapping plot that defrauded a Minnesota family of $8 million in cryptocurrency have pleaded guilty. The case highlights the risks of digital asset theft through coercion and criminal activity.

linkedin_post:
The gap between 'crypto-native' and 'mainstream retail' is closing, but not in the way many expected. While we see legacy L1s struggling with leadership churn and token devaluation, the real growth is happening at the edges: NFT IP entering Target stores and emerging market regulators in the Philippines embracing RWA tokenization.

Success in the current cycle isn't about chasing the next hype-cycle L1; it's about bridging digital ownership with physical utility and regulated financial rails. Whether it's Pudgy Penguins scaling via big-box retail or Levl hitting $1B in payment volume, the thesis is clear: Value accrues where Web3 infrastructure solves a tangible, real-world friction point.

Are we entering an era where the 'crypto' part of the business becomes invisible to the end consumer?
